units.title: Classification of a product-and-sum functional equation
units.statement: For λ>0, all functions f from the positive reals to the reals satisfying f(xy)=λf(x)f(y)f(x+y) are the three constant functions 0, 1/√λ, and −1/√λ. If f(1)=0, x=1 forces f=0. Otherwise x and 1/x force every value to be nonzero. Then x=1 makes f constant above 1; substituting two inputs above 1 gives the squared constant 1/λ, and a sufficiently large first input propagates it to all positive arguments.
steps: Separate the f(1)=0 case and prove nonvanishing from x·(1/x)=1
Use x=1 to make f constant on (1,∞)
Determine the constant and extend it below 1 using a large input
